name: flint_pickaxe
what: a flint pickaxe: a curved crescent head spanning about two-thirds of the canvas, made of crude knapped grey-brown flint with chipped faceted edges and a few lighter flake scars, lashed with tan sinew cord to a plain wooden handle, lying diagonally, handle at the bottom left, tip at the top right, filling the canvas corner to corner

name: copper_pickaxe
